title: Why averaging averages changes the answer
method: Synthetic store A sells 10 units for 100; B sells 90 for 450. Their averages are 10 and 5. Unweighted(10+5)/2=7.5; combined(100+450)/(10+90)=5.5. Uses common currency and comparable units; no customer sales data.
alt: Why averaging averages changes the answer. Store A average: 10 currency units per unit; Store B average: 5 currency units per unit; Unweighted average: 7.5 currency units per unit; Combined weighted average: 5.5 currency units per unit. Illustrative values.
